kithcraftPurposes.VillagerGoalPackagesMixin: Suppresses villager breeding (FR-004, card AC #2): drops VillagerMakeLove from VillagerGoalPackages.getIdlePackage's returned behavior list before any Brain is built from it. registerBrainGoals is private and Brain.addActivity is additive-only, so this is the only place a stock vanilla behavior can be omitted (specs/014-augmented-villager/research/brain-26.2.md).
kithcraftPurposes.VillagerGossipMixin: Suppresses gossip exchange AND, as a direct side effect, iron-golem summoning (FR-004, card AC #2): Villager.gossip(ServerLevel, Villager, long) calls spawnGolemIfNeeded from inside its own body, so cancelling gossip at HEAD covers both targets in one injection -- the Mixin budget lands at 2 overrides, not 3 (brain-26.2.md §5).
